name: microduck
one_liner: A tiny two-legged robot duck kit that walks using machine-learning control, built to be assembled and programmed by hobbyists and students.
buyer: A STEM education company or robotics club organizer looking for an affordable, engaging hands-on robotics kit.
business_use_cases: A STEM education company sells assembled or kit versions of it as classroom robotics projects for middle/high schoolers.
A robotics YouTuber or maker builds a paid build-along course teaching assembly and the reinforcement-learning control code.
A university robotics lab uses it as a cheap physical testbed for teaching reinforcement learning to students.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-assembled or kitted versions with a printed guide to schools and hobbyists.
Sell a paid video course walking through assembly and training the walking policy.

steal_this: Build one this weekend, film the assembly and first steps, and list it as a paid build-along course or a kit on a maker marketplace.
